JVNDB-2026-000123
Android App "Myna Point" vulnerable to improper access restriction
Overview
Android App "Myna Point" provided by Digital Agency contains the following vulnerability.
Improper Authorization in Handler for Custom URL Scheme (CWE-939) - CVE-2026-73335
RyotaK of GMO Flatt Security Inc. reported this vulnerability to the developer and IPA.
JPCERT/CC coordinated with the developer to publish the advisory under Information Security Early Warning Partnership.

Affected Products
Digital Agency
Android App "Myna Point" versions 2.0.6 and prior
Impact
A malicious application installed on the user's Android device may exploit the affected application's functionality through an Intent, potentially allowing arbitrary JavaScript to be executed within the affected application.
Solution
[Update the application]
Update the application to the latest version according to the information provided by the developer.
